english.title: Arrange a meeting to support proscribed organisation - terrorism
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[arranged]_
(B)_[managed]_
(C)_[assisted in the arrangement of]_
(D)_[assisted in the management of]_

a meeting, which you knew was to

(E)_[support]_
(F)_[further the activities of]_
(G)_[be addressed by a person who belonged or professed to belong to]_

a proscribed organisation, namely **(..SPECIFY ORGANISATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 12(2) and (6) of the Terrorism Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Attorney General is required, section 117 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
(ii) See Schedule 2 for a list of proscribed organisations.
(iii) See section 12(5) for the definition of 'meeting'.
(iv) The maximum penalty increased from 29th June 2021, see H22763/PT00075.

other.penalty:
Summary: six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
